data.page_content_preview:
...

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

These classic blueberry scones are tender, buttery, and bursting with fresh blueberries. They're perfect for a weekend breakfast or a delightful afternoon treat.

Details

  • Prep Time: 15 minutes
  • Cook Time: 18-20 minutes
  • Total Time: 35 minutes
  • Yield: 8 scones
  • Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  10. Let cool slightly before serving.

Tips

  • Keep butter cold for flaky scones.
  • Don't overmix the dough.

data.title: Blueberry Scones | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These homemade blueberry scones are buttery, lightly sweet, and bursting with fresh berries. Quick to make, they're the ideal treat.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream, plus more for brushing
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for topping (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a small bowl, mix the heavy cream and vanilla. Pour over dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
  6. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Notes

For best results, keep all ingredients cold. Frozen blueberries work well—do not thaw before adding. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days.

...

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.
